enforcement.before: A new installation starts without an active integration. An existing installation may expose a different contract.
enforcement.after: The root-first controller delivers a material-dependency-bound acquisition instruction, compact immutable response records and content-identified shared procedure definitions with exact resolution. The acquire contact point returns bounded UTF-8 segments with explicit correlation, completion and failure states. Optional operation entry/completion retain native meaning without user-turn or governance-revision churn. Governed knowledge declarations, shared mandatory view, stop behavior and independent authority retain their applicable contracts. Context exposes tool_instructions, versioned knowledge_contract, plan references and continuation obligations. Current record/profile/index format 2 replaces incompatible current structures; declarations stay format 1. The validator adds schema, profile --previous and work-item --history. Strict owned readers reconcile added fields and knowledge plan/index diagnostics; generic native event decoding and contact-point vectors remain applicable.
enforcement.rationale: The initial distribution supplies a complete context-aware declarative adapter and a definition-aware receiving contract. Discover actual owned capabilities and administrative receipts, preserve disabled handlers and peer state, and reconcile only unsupported owned readers or bindings. No predecessor release, full live event coverage or peer adoption is asserted.
enforcement.already_satisfied: Owned adapter readers accept the current interface and actual administrative receipts remain valid; SHA/status alone is insufficient.
enforcement.recovery: Inspect actual active configuration and journal phase under an exclusive owned lock; preserve verified active on staging failure; reconcile activated_pending_checkpoint before advancement. Never remove ongoing/recovery code or advance peer adoption.
enforcement.retention: one active plus at most one ordinary transient candidate; preserve referenced historical evidence explicitly inactive

adapter_reconciliation.assurance: Current observed-state reconciliation, not a predecessor release claim or consumer functional certification.

enforcement.target_commit: Resolve containing OOP version control commit after publication; never a future self-SHA.

current.state_schema: Initial OOP contract: independent installation ownership, dedicated tool-type guidance, formal scoped grants, versioned validated plans, immutable profile provenance, knowledge records/profile/index format 2, declaration format 1, closure-bound historical validation and complete source-derived context.
current.read_compatibility: Verify per-domain actual state under existing canonical policy.
current.write_compatibility: Current governed knowledge records, profiles and indexes require format 2 and exact plan validation plus approved-concept incorporation before dependent execution; declarations remain format 1. Reconcile only affected open work under current authority, preserving actual evidence. Incompatible indexes fail distinctly from unavailable stores; regenerate them from current profiles. Closed archives retain supported actual closure schemas/profile snapshots; unknown history remains unverified and cannot authorize current work.
current.existing_state_policy: Preserve safely interpretable history and adequate canonical knowledge; reconcile current coverage, mandatory generated views and owned activation before dependent work. Never fabricate historical profile use, replay shared effects or rewrite peer-owned checkpoints. Establish current knowledge coverage before each affected open-item transition using accessible material evidence; preserve closed archives, missing-source uncertainty and peer state. Prepare and read back the dedicated tool-type guide under verified ownership; retain native consent receipts per installation. Regenerate shared grant projections from authorized sources. Migrate affected open records and legacy profile revisions explicitly; no bulk archive rewrite or retrospective fabricated plan validation.

support_evidence: Reviewed initial source distribution and independently owned state contracts; no release predecessor or migration effects are asserted.
unsupported: Any other observed state is unsupported: retain verified adoption facts, block dependent unsafe work and perform a fresh runtime bootstrap preserving organizational data, private secrets and peer state.
